articles.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
articles.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.

articles.title: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
articles.description: The price of Brent crude rose more than 6% on Thursday as the war in the Middle East continues to escalate.
